title: Close-area local planners: DWA (Nav2-style dynamic window) and Bug2 / TangentBug, range sensor only, next to APF and VFH+ on 72-beam and Crazyflie-like 4-beam fans
summary: Two more classic map-free local planners for close-area A=>B, written as close-area-arena Planners that read only the pose and the range scan, and measured on the same arena families and fans as the reactive sample. dwa.py: holonomic dynamic window approach (Fox, Burgard, Thrun 1997; the idea behind Nav2's DWB controller): (vx, vy) samples in the window the arena vehicle can reach in 0.2 s at 3 m/s^2, 1.5 s rollouts through the arena's velocity-lag model, admissibility by clearance and braking distance, cost = heading to B + clearance + speed with named weights; memory_s gives a dwa_mem variant with 3 s of remembered returns. bug.py: Bug2 (m-line, fixed-side wall follow, m-line leave rule, unreachable exit) and TangentBug (free-segment test, range-discontinuity tangent points, heuristic-rise switch to boundary following, d_reach < d_followed leave rule, one-scan dropout hold), state machines documented in the file. bench.py runs DWA, dwa_mem, Bug2, TangentBug, APF with wall-follow escape and VFH+ (imported unchanged from close-area-planner-reactive) on random, u_trap and narrow_gap, 50 layouts each, with the 72-beam 6 m fan and a 4-beam 4 m Multi-ranger-like fan, and reports path length against a known-map A* length. tune.py holds the dev-seed sweep and a narrow-gap time-budget check. Synthetic arena only.
verified: ran 2026-11-09 with CPython 3.12.10 + numpy 2.5.4 / scipy 1.18.1 on an Apple M3 Max (macOS 26.6.2), in the sample venv (requirements.txt reuses the arena's): bench.py --layouts 50 --seed 0 wrote results/dwa_bug_0.* in 730.7 s wall; a second run with --only dwa,bug2,tangent_bug --no-write printed identical rows for those 18 cells (dwa_mem not re-run). The APF and VFH+ rows match results/reactive_0.md of close-area-planner-reactive cell for cell. tune.py (seed 1, 20 layouts) wrote results/dev_seed1_tuning.md and tune.py --budget-check wrote results/dev_seed1_budget.md. Every number in README is from results/. test_smoke.py: 1 passed in the venv, 1 skipped under plain python3 3.14.6 without numpy. No arena or reactive-sample file was edited. Layouts, vehicle and sensor are simulated; the 4-beam fan is a geometry model of the Multi-ranger; dwa_mem remembers returns with the truth pose; no SITL, no Crazyflie, no Nav2.
shows: DWA (with and without scan memory), Bug2 and TangentBug from range returns only, next to APF and VFH+, on random, U-trap and narrow-gap layouts with a 72-beam fan and a Crazyflie-like 4-beam fan; reached, collisions, path length vs known-map A*
runtime: ~12 min for 50 layouts x 3 families x 2 fans x 6 planners (dwa_mem ~7 min of it)
key_result: [50 layouts per cell, seed 0](README.md#results-ran-2026-11-09-apple-m3-max-macos-2662-cpython-31210-numpy-254-scipy-1181): 72 beams: TangentBug reached 92 % random, 86 % u_trap, 58 % narrow_gap with 0 % collisions; Bug2 94 % u_trap but 0 % narrow_gap; DWA 0 % u_trap. 4 beams: APF with escape stays best on random (82 %, 8 % collisions); 3 s of scan memory cut DWA collisions from 52 % to 18 %
